_: Drink photo per drink, keyed by the Hebrew name in drinks.json. Source: Canva folder FAHUB4yCGHI (10 family subfolders, 48 designs, one per drink), mapped 2026-09-02 by matching each Canva design title to the drink; all 48 matched unambiguously. Re-cut 2026-09-03 by tools/landing-pages/cut_shots.py from fresh Canva exports (transparent PNG, 1560 tall) -- see that file for how a glass is told from its shadow, and why the previous cut could not. The short version: the first pass trimmed to the alpha bounding box at alpha>=160, which is above the glass's own translucent wall, so 45 of the 48 shipped with the drink or its shadow sliced flat against an edge. Every shot is now placed on one shared 925x1052 canvas with the glass scaled to a common height and set on a common baseline, and the rest of the canvas is room for the drop shadow -- the widest overhang any of the 48 needs. Nothing is cut: the strongest alpha touching any canvas edge across all 48 is 7 out of 255. Because the canvas is identical on every shot the card's box only has to match its aspect ratio, and the 48 glasses line up by construction rather than by luck. Uploaded to Shopify Files as gtd-<design>.webp via stagedUploadsCreate + fileCreate, so the pages reference cdn.shopify.com and the theme carries no image weight. 'canva' is the design id: re-export from it if a photo has to be regenerated. The superseded gt-<design>.webp files are left in Shopify Files.
